name: Barbapapa: One Big Happy Family!
description: The daily life of the extraordinary blob-shaped Barbapapa family, who can morph into other forms but retain their original colors. The Barbapapa family consists of parents Barbapapa and Barbamama and their seven children; the intellectual Barbalib, the coquette Barbabelle, the powerful Barbabravo, inventor Barbabright, animal lover Barbazoo, artist Barbabeau, and musician Barbalala, along with their pet dog, Lolita.

videos.title: Roy
videos.overview: Barbabright creates a vacuuming robot that's also very good at soccer. The Barbababies organise a match against the robots.

videos.title: Making Bread
videos.overview: Barbapapa wants to teach his children to make bread, but things don't go as planned...

videos.title: The Great Spring Clean
videos.overview: Barbamama wants the barbababies to tidy their bedrooms. They're hiding to escape the drudgery.

videos.title: Be Patient Barbabravo...
videos.overview: Barbabravo can't stay put and is unable to focus one an activity for very long. Barbalala offers to teach him control. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Bada-Bam
videos.overview: Barbabright captured a melody from Mars. The Barbapapas build a rocket to go to the red planet.

videos.title: The Barbamartians
videos.overview: While travelling to Mars, the Barbapapas meet a family of Barbamartians. They have no time to get acquainted when a giant plant attacks the village.

videos.title: The Barbababies' World
videos.overview: The Barbapapa family spends a day at the beach. Divided into 2 teams, the barbababies fight over a sandy peninsula.

videos.title: Where Did it Go, Barbabravo?
videos.overview: Like a secret agent, Barbabravo leads the investigation equipped with his gadgets to find out who stole Barbapapa's cake.

videos.title: Barbazoo Can't Say "No"
videos.overview: Barbazoo is ready to help. But Barbabright and Barbabelle abuse his kindness and drive him crazy

videos.title: From One Pit to Another
videos.overview: The Barbababies plant an avocado tree. However, it takes years before the first harvest. Barbabright has an idea to save time that may well lead to...disaster.

videos.title: Relay Tales
videos.overview: Barbalib, Barbalala and Barbabelle take turns as narrators to tell a story, each one bringing a very personal touch to it.

videos.title: Where Is Bali?
videos.overview: Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

videos.title: The Barbapapa Tree
videos.overview: Barbapapa and Barbamama return to the tree they were born under. It's in bad condition. They must rescue it quickly without disturbing the nearby animals

videos.title: The Competition Prize
videos.overview: The Barbabies win a touchpad. They all want to use it and snaffle it one after another.

videos.title: Boris
videos.overview: The barbababies find a lost baby elephant and secretly look after it. How will Barbapapa and Barbamama react to Boris?

videos.title: Super Duper Cool
videos.overview: The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

videos.title: Born to Be Wild
videos.overview: Boris the elephant misses home. The Barbapapa decide to bring him back to Africa. On the spot, they help Boris to acclimatize

videos.title: The Tenderest Bond of All
videos.overview: While the family makes pottery, Barbabravo and Barbabright try to set the world record for the largest cheese soufflé.

videos.title: The Cave Barbapapas
videos.overview: The barbababies discover a strange cave. Barbalib tells the story of the caves Barbapapa and how they transformed.

videos.title: Marvelous Moustaches
videos.overview: Barbazoo collects photos of moustached celebrities. Unfortunately, it's impossible to find the last one: Charles Horseshoe-Furlip. He suspects a conspiracy...

videos.title: The Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Mr. Strict's twins visit the barbababies. The barbababies organize a treasure hunt for the twins and enjoy the great outdoors.

videos.title: The Perfect Dinner
videos.overview: Barbapapa and Barbamama go out to celebrate their birthdays. Barbabelle is in charge and gets overwhelmed

videos.title: The Seven Foods
videos.overview: The Barbababies think their food can make them change colours and shapes. They decide to find the right food for each of them

videos.title: The Orange Empire
videos.overview: The Barbapapas decide to go to the park. While her brother and sisters play , Barbalib can't help to control everything.

videos.title: Going into the Wild
videos.overview: The Barbapapas are off to a new adventure... in the garden. But living in nature is more complicated than they expected.

videos.title: The Doppelganger
videos.overview: By chance, Barbazoo realizes he can imitate Barbapapa. He uses this opportunity to distribute chores to his brothers and sisters. Will they find out?

videos.title: The Perfect Portrait
videos.overview: Barbabeau lacks inspiration, he can't create anymore. The whole family helps by suggesting new subjects to paint.

videos.title: Clock and Dance
videos.overview: The barbababies prepare a show for Barbamama's birthday. While Barbalala finishes up, they go to the carnival where Barbabeau gets stuck in an attraction.

videos.title: Hiccupism
videos.overview: Barbabeau can't paint. He has a hiccup he can't get rid of. Just when he's about to give up, he accidentally creates a new artistic movement.

videos.title: Double Dare You
videos.overview: On a ski trip, the Barbapapas build a giant igloo. Barbabravo and Barbalib challenge each other to find out who is braver.

videos.title: When I Grow Up
videos.overview: A bird builds its nest on Barbazoo's belly. Barbazoo wants to become a big tree to shelter animals. This becomes complicated.

videos.title: It's Only a Mystery...
videos.overview: Taking after his favourite detective, Barbabravo looks for a case to solve. Can he solve the mystery of the missing ice statue?

videos.title: The Little Monsters
videos.overview: The Barbababies have a sleepover in the living room. Fearing the monsters in the closet, they set up wacky traps to catch them.

videos.title: The Kittens
videos.overview: Barbabelle watches Bali's kittens. She's scared something will happen and won't let them out. Barbamama must intervene to help the kittens.

videos.title: The Grass Is Always Greener...
videos.overview: Barbabright coats the house in magic product to prevent water leakage. The next day, The house deflates like a balloon.

videos.title: The Battle
videos.overview: Inspired by their favourite heroes, the Barbababies make costumes. But no heroes are possible without villains.

videos.title: Let Justice Be Done
videos.overview: Barbabeau forgot to return his book to the library. As Mr Strict the librarian is visiting Barbapapa today, Barbabeau decides to run away.

videos.title: Barbapileup
videos.overview: Three separate stories telescope into a big final bouquet in the middle of the courtyard.

videos.title: The Barbababies' Birthday
videos.overview: It's the Barbababies's birthday. They all want to do something different with Barbapapa!

videos.title: Barba TV
videos.overview: The barbababies are glued to the TV. Since they love it so much, their parents encourage them to make their own shows.

videos.title: Barbabravo Is Not Feeling Well
videos.overview: Following a misadventure, Barbabravo is unable to transform at all. The whole family unites to help him.

videos.title: The Big Bad Hen
videos.overview: Barbalala is convinced she heard a giant hen prowling around the house. The Barbababies organize themselves to stand guard.

videos.title: Barbabright Has a Secret
videos.overview: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out.

videos.title: The Fuchsia Ocean
videos.overview: Chemical sprays are making the countryside rosy! The Barbapapas' build an aviary to protect sick birds

videos.title: The Museum
videos.overview: The Barbapapa visit the museum of evolution. On the program: creation of the Earth, Precambrian submarine and... dinosaurs!

videos.title: Zero Waste
videos.overview: When they see a beach covered with rubbish, the Barbapapa family decides to clean the beach and use the trash to make a miniature golf course.

videos.title: Greedyguts
videos.overview: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path!

videos.title: Silence Please
videos.overview: Barbalib wants to compete in a writing contest but his brothers and sisters stop her from concentrating.

videos.title: The Sand is disappearing
videos.overview: During one of their great adventures, Barbapapa and Lolita were traveling in a balloon, but caught in a storm they ended up stranded on a deserted island. At first disoriented, they eventually settled in comfortably and lived very happily there, until the day their beautiful island disappeared.

videos.title: Barbazoo's Diary
videos.overview: Barbazoo recounts the exciting Day he had

videos.title: Opposite Day
videos.overview: Barbalala has decided to respect all the rules of the day of opposites, a custom that comes from very ancient times. Her brothers and sisters join her and it's time for a day of opposites!

videos.title: Biodisaster
videos.overview: Barbabright and Barbabeau have designed a huge wooden toy powered by an engine using bio oil. Upon seeing their creation, Barbapapa decides to tell them a memorable adventure with Lolita, during which he discovered the process of making this "ecological fuel."

videos.title: Buttercup
videos.overview: Barbazoo's beautiful roses mysteriously disappeared during the night. He's sure it's Barbelle's doing! But how can he get a confession? Barbazoo decides to give her a special doll to better keep an eye on her.

videos.title: If I were a Billionaire
videos.overview: If I were a billionaire, what would I do to achieve my dreams? Each of the barbababies has a very specific idea of what they would do

videos.title: Lots of Insects
videos.overview: Barbabelle had a restless night because of the crickets, and to top it off, she was bitten by a mosquito and chased by a wasp. She's had enough of all these insects! But does she know how important they are for the balance of nature? Fortunately, Barbapapa is there to explain and show her how to protect them

videos.title: Barbabravo's Adventure
videos.overview: Barbabravo is moping with boredom, his brothers and sisters are all busy and no one wants to play with him. He decides to go for a walk alone. Upon his return, Barbamama asks him to tell about his day. Barbabravo then launches into an epic story, recounting how after surviving a shipwreck, he was saved by a goddess. Stranded on a distant island, he had to participate in the Olympics and face a giant

videos.title: Princess for a Day
videos.overview: Barbabelle proudly announces to her family that she wants to become a princess. Despite the warnings from Barbalib who explains to her that it is not an easy task. The whole family then decides to support her and train her in her new royal duties.

videos.title: Summer Camp 1
videos.overview: Barbapapa and Barbamama have announced to their dear barbababies that they are going on a trip to Easter Island. Meanwhile, the Barbababies will go to summer camp with Mr. Strict and his twins to go camping by a lake. Excited about this idea, the barbababies will quickly realize that setting up a camping camp is not easy... But who knows, maybe it could still be fun?

videos.title: Summer Camp 2
videos.overview: Camping near a lake, the Barbababies, the twins, and Mr. Strict set sail on "Thésée", a magnificent sailboat. Everything is calm, but sailing on a lake is sometimes not so easy, especially when the wind picks up like a tornado. It will take all the courage of the Barbababies to avoid shipwreck and return safely to their parents.

videos.title: Moving Mission
videos.overview: During a walk, the Barbapapa family discovers a megalith. Each of the barbababies puts forward their own hypothesis about the presence of this imposing monument, how it was erected and transported here in ancient times. Barbamama then decides to pass on to the whole family the techniques that were used at that time

videos.title: The Birth of Barbapapa
videos.overview: When young François goes to water his flowers one beautiful spring morning, he doesn't expect to witness the birth of Barbapapa. What a surprise, it's very rare!!! Barbapapa, François and his neighbor Claudine immediately become friends and François asks his father Edmond to welcome Barbapapa into their home. Unfortunately, Edmond doesn't agree and Barbapapa will have to go to the zoo...

videos.title: The Reveal
videos.overview: Barbapapa is now a prisoner in the zoo. Locked up and desperate, he makes a chance discovery that reveals the true talent of the Barbapapa: transformation! Thanks to this ability, he manages to escape from his cage, but Mac Ravache, the owner of the zoo, is determined to catch him. Will Barbapapa be able to regain his freedom?

videos.title: Barbapapa's Family
videos.overview: After leaving the zoo, Barbapapa finds refuge in the house that François' parents built for him. However, in the spring, a melancholic sadness takes hold of him. Worried, Jeanne and Edmond take him to Doctor Alcibiade who confirms that Barbapapa is in excellent health. Jeanne then has an idea: to regain his smile Barbapapa needs a Barbamama! But where to find her? Maybe on the moon?

videos.title: Barbapapa's House
videos.overview: Barbapapa is worried: the house built by Edmond and Jeanne is far too small now that Barbamama and the Barbabébé have arrived in his life. They need a new home! That's when François finds a charming mansion in the city, which will be perfect once it's repaired. The whole family gets to work and prepares to move in, but Mac Ravache, now an entrepreneur, decides to demolish it to build apartment buildings. Faced with this situation, the Barbapapa family leaves the city and discovers a wonderful corner of paradise in the middle of nature. An ideal place to build their new home together.

videos.title: Invasion
videos.overview: Barbalala received a package sent by her Brazilian correspondent, inside she discovers two beautiful little pink animals that she names the SQUEAKIES. In no time, the SQUEAKIES multiply and end up invading the entire house. Barbapapa then explains that certain animal and plant species must remain in their natural habitat to avoid disturbing the ecological balance. Let's go on an adventure, we must bring the SQUEAKIES back to Brazil!

videos.title: Child of the Stars 1
videos.overview: While they were scanning the sky in search of the comet Proteus, Barbabright and Lolita spotted a flying saucer approaching their house. Without wasting any time, Barbapapa woke up the whole family to discover the identity of these space travelers. But of course, they were their martian friends and they had a special guest with them: a baby with big feet mysteriously appeared on their planet. The Barbapapa then offered to find his family. Thus, a new mission is announced for Badabam, the rocket, which eagerly sniffs the baby's teddy bear in search of a trail in the stars

videos.title: Child of the Stars 2
videos.overview: The Barbapapa have taken off aboard Bababam in the hope of discovering the planet of Baby Big Feet. But not everything goes as planned, and Badabam, rendered out of control by Barbabravo, lands in a strange place. How will they manage to get out of it and find the planet of Baby Big Feet?

videos.title: Roboxman
videos.overview: The barbababies are going to the hypermarket for the first time. With all these products, it must be an exceptional place! But why is everything wrapped in plastic? It's probably Robemballeur's fault...

videos.title: Watch out for Barbabright
videos.overview: When the twins visit Barbabright's room, they are surprised at every turn because for each area of the room, chemistry, electronics, and mechanics... Barbabright has an incredible story to tell them!

videos.title: Barbabright's Invention
videos.overview: Barbabright is tired of constantly searching for the same objects and has a stroke of genius: the invention of the "BAM". It is a ribbon that he wears on his head and that allows him to easily store everything. However, Barbalib quickly realizes the commercial potential of this invention and takes matters into her own hands, to the detriment of Barbabright and the environment

videos.title: Dreaming Apprentices
videos.overview: While everyone sleeps peacefully, one may wonder what Barbabravo, Barbalala, and Barbalib could be dreaming about. After all, dreams are opportunities to learn, grow, and explore our imagination. And what about Lolita?

videos.title: Bbarbalalalalala
videos.overview: Barbalala is a great composer and music is her whole life! Yes, but sometimes you also have to tidy up your room, do your homework, and help your brothers and sisters when parents give them small tasks. That's also what family life is about!

videos.title: The Decoder
videos.overview: Barbabright has created a clever decoder capable of translating the cries of animals into our language, but the animals on the farm and in the garden are not very captivating. Barbazoo then suggests going to listen to marine animals.

videos.title: One last Story, then off to Bed
videos.overview: The Barbababies love bedtime stories, except if they are always the same... Fortunately, Barbamama decides to revisit children's tales with all her imagination! It's so much fun and we learn so many things, that we would like it to never end

videos.title: I'm Not A Barbababy Anymore
videos.overview: No! No! No! It's over! Barbabravo is no longer a baby, he's a big boy now! And today, he's going to live his day like a big boy: no more naps, no more snacks, and no more playing with his brothers and sisters.

videos.title: My beautiful Castle
videos.overview: During a bike ride, the Barbapapa family discovers an old medieval castle in ruins. They cannot leave it in this state and quickly begin to restore it. Then, at nightfall, while everyone is asleep, Barbazoo hears strange noises coming from the castle. Quickly joined by Barbalala and Barbabright, they decide to investigate these mysterious sounds. Let's go on a ghost hunt!

videos.title: Innovation Melting Pot
videos.overview: When Barbabright explains to his brothers and sisters what a brilliant inventor Leonardo da Vinci was, each of them wants to create their own invention. Not everyone is a genius, but it's still very fun to invent.

videos.title: Vandal!
videos.overview: Barbabravo catches a mysterious masked vandal who has just fled after painting on the wall of the house. This is a case for detective Barbirlock and doctor Barbabelson!

videos.title: The green Algae
videos.overview: Green algae are dangerous! And Barbamama wants to know more about these algae that have invaded the beach where her children play. She is determined to stop this foul pollution

videos.title: Private Club
videos.overview: Barbabeau, Barbabelle, and Barbabright have built a treehouse. The other Barbababies are curious and would like to discover this incredible place, but it is a private club whose access is reserved for members who have passed certain tests. Is it really worth it? Is the place as extraordinary as it seems? Is it worth causing discord among the Barbababies?

videos.title: Prank Day
videos.overview: Barbabravo, Barbalala and Barbabeau are fed up with their brothers and sisters laughing at their expense. We need to organize the most incredible prank to win the prank war.

videos.title: Holey the Snowman
videos.overview: The snow fell without warning, and the Barbababies took advantage of it to have a big snowball fight, except for Barbabeau who crafted a magnificent snowman that the children named Bobo. But how can they preserve Bobo when spring comes? A race against time begins.

videos.title: The Puppet
videos.overview: When they discover Bibabobu, the puppet made by Barbabeau, the Barbababies decide to create a show and go all out! Each one has their own role, and all the stage professions will be represented.

videos.title: Going with the Flow
videos.overview: The Barbababies are bored, the rain is preventing them from playing outside. Fortunately, Barbamama and Barbapapa know that with a little imagination, you can do lots of things in the rain. And imagination! The Barbababies have plenty of it, sometimes even too much

videos.title: The Louvre
videos.overview: On a trip to Paris, the Barbapapa family will discover the most incredible museum: the Louvre! Unfortunately, Barbalala has overlooked a crucial detail, it is strictly forbidden to eat in a museum..

videos.title: Great Reporter
videos.overview: After reading the biography of Nellie Bly, Barbalib is determined to become a Great Reporter! But how can she create a newspaper with interesting articles that appeal to everyone when she is too young to explore the world?

videos.title: Cowgirl
videos.overview: Barbalala dreams of becoming a cowgirl and Barbazoo is determined to help her. To achieve this, she must learn to take care of the cows and the bull. It's not an easy task, but if she remains perseverant, Barbalala should become a great cowgirl

videos.title: Tumbles, Where Did You Go?
videos.overview: Tumbles, Barbabravo's favorite toy car, has mysteriously disappeared in the living room. While searching for it, Barbabravo, Barbabelle, and Barbabright discover a strange hole under the couch... What if Tumbles had fallen to the center of the earth?

videos.title: The Barbababies Have Got Talent
videos.overview: oday is the big talent competition organized by Barbalala. Every barbababy is invited to show their greatest talent on stage, but be careful, Barbalala will be uncompromising!

videos.title: Living Together
videos.overview: For the very first time, the Barbababies will take the train and sleep in a hotel. Barbamama will accompany them, while Barbapapa will join them by road with the load of pottery. The big annual fair is approaching and Barbamama must sell all her creations there, provided that Barbapapa manages to bring them on time.

videos.title: Rebels
videos.overview: arbapapa explains to Barbabravo and Barbalala that no one can stop them from playing as they wish, but the two children may not have understood very well that Barbapapa did not authorize them to become little rebels

videos.title: Gloop Gloop Ah-Ah
videos.overview: How delicious lemonade is! Everyone wants more! That's Barbalib's great idea - to start a business and create the best lemonade

videos.title: Make Up Your Mind Barbazoo
videos.overview: The Barbababies must choose between going to the pool or going for a bike ride. Immediately, two camps form, each with their own preference, and only Barbazoo can tip the balance. What should they choose? He doesn't know, it's so difficult to decide. His brothers and sisters will try to convince him.

videos.title: Paper Landscapes
videos.overview: Barbamama and Barbapapa are surprised to see more and more billboards on the road. Light pollution makes the stars invisible and you can't walk without bumping into a pole. Enough is enough! We must act as a family

videos.title: Barbascience
videos.overview: But who are the Barbapapa? They come in all colors, can transform at will, and some are hairy... Only Barbascience can answer that.

videos.title: We Need To Save The Corals
videos.overview: Children discover a photo of baby Lolita in the family album. Barbapapa then decides to tell the barbababies about the time he went with Lolita to explore the Arctic and the seabed on board the Barbotilus

videos.title: Triple Switcheroo
videos.overview: Video games are fun, but you also need to know how to enjoy the nice weather! Barbamama and Barbapapa decide to create outdoor adventure games for the Barbababies. Be careful when distributing roles and puzzles to everyone, as this could create misunderstandings

videos.title: The Mountain Eater
videos.overview: Some animals are very scary and seem very dangerous! Barbapapa tells the Barbababies about his extraordinary adventure with Lolita climbing the Pic des Ducs and their encounter with the wolf

videos.title: The First Day Of School
videos.overview: Tomorrow is the Barbababies' first day of school, and each one is preparing in their own way. It's a bit stressful to go to school for the first time, you have to think of everything.
